messages:
matt: Hey team — noticed a weird delta in a handful of invoices after yesterday's route-resolver rollout. Token counts look right upstream, but invoice line items got attributed to the fallback route instead of the original tenant route. Anyone else seeing this?

deepti: Ugh. I saw a couple anomalies in the metering preview too. Quick question — are we still dropping route_tag in the enrichment step when resolver returns multiple candidates?

ben: Not supposed to. The aggregator should prefer explicit route_tag from the resolver metadata, fallback only if missing. Can you paste an example, matt?

matt: Pasting minimal sanitized event we saw in the billing snapshot (copied from log):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_8Xz","tenant_id":"t-123","seq_len":128,"tokens":42,"resolver":{ "chosen":"region-eu-1", "priority": 20}, "enriched": {"model":"redwood-7b"}}
```
Invoice builder received this and created invoice line with route_id = "fallback-standard".

ingest-bot: processed event evt_8Xz -> enriched at 2026-03-19T22:11:03Z, route_tag not present in enrichment payload, assigned fallback: fallback-standard

deepti: Hmm, ingest-bot indicates route_tag missing. That means something stripped the resolver.chosen -> enriched.route_tag mapping. The mapping lives in ingest/enrich/service v2. Did the resolver contract change with the rollout?

olivia: We did change resolver to return a candidates array for multi-homing. New shape: {candidates:[{id,priority}], chosen: id}. ingest/enrich v2 should read chosen but maybe the field name changed to chosenId in the rollout. @kevin, any rollout notes?

kevin: I pushed the resolver change. The JSON key is still "chosen" on my branch — but I did rename the internal var. Could be a side effect of the compatibility shim we added. Will check.

ben: To shortcut — the aggregator and the invoice transformer should not rely on heuristics if there is a resolver payload present. We should include a defensive rule: when resolver exists, set invoice.route_source = "resolver" and invoice.route_debug = base64(enriched.resolver). That will make root cause obvious in previews.

sara: Agree. Also console preview currently only shows route_id and plan. We need a tiny UX change to show route_source and route_priority in the invoice preview modal so ops can see why something was routed to fallback. Right now it just says "fallback-standard" which is useless.

ops: For incident workflows, add an alert when aggregated invoice lines get flagged as fallback but inbound events had a non-empty resolver. 1) alert channel, 2) sampling of raw events attached. Saves time.

matt: Good plan. Short-term mitigation: can we add a one-line transform in the invoice builder that, if resolver exists and resolver.chosen != null, prefer that value even if route_tag absent? That should fix the immediate mis-attribution.

deepti: I can push a hotfix to invoice-builder: simple patch -> when resolver.chosen present use that as route_id. I'll add a unit test. Also adding a telemetry tag "route_resolution_source" = "invoice-hotfix-20260319" so we can filter.

billing-bot: NOTE: any hotfix that changes invoice formation will require sign-off from finance. @sara can you coordinate a quick approval?

ben: Also let's make the metering pipeline emit a sticky field: resolved_route = resolver.chosen || enriched.route_tag || fallback. That gives deterministic downstream behavior. We'll add it to the schema as string resolved_route.

olivia: For longer term we should update the resolver contract and the enrich service in tandem in the same rollout window. The multi-candidate change needs an explicit compatibility shim in enrich service. I'll open a small RFC.

kevin: Found it — the resolver did return {chosen} but a JSON encoder change in the shim serialized chosen as null when candidates.length == 1. That's why ingest logged route_tag missing. I'll revert the shim and re-run integration tests.

matt: Nice catch. But we still should do ben/deepti's defensive patches so this doesn't bite us again.

deepti: Working on invoice-builder PR now. ETA ~2h for a patch and tests. I'll also add the telemetry tag.

ops: I'll add an alert rule: when invoice_line.route_id == "fallback-standard" and event_count(sampled)>0 and any(sampled.resolver)!=null then alert to #eng-platform-pager and attach 10 sample events.

billing-bot: Finance approval requested for hotfix -> @sara. Please respond with :+1: or :no_entry_sign:

sara: reviewing now. This change is safe as long as it's patch-only and reversible. :+1: from me for the hotfix, but we need a postmortem note in the billing runbook.

ben: Follow-ups: 1) schema bump for metering events to include resolved_route and route_debug; 2) console preview add resolved_route and route_priority; 3) aggregator test that simulates shim-encoded-null cases. I'll file tickets.

matt: Thanks everyone. deepti — ping here when PR is up and I'll pair with you on canary deploy to staging. We'll validate invoice previews before promoting.

deepti: PR: https://git.redwood/internal/invoice-builder/pull/452 (hotfix branch: prefer-resolver-chosen). Running unit + e2e on staging canary now.

ingest-bot: canary run ingests: 1200 events sampled, resolved_route populated for 1198 events. 2 events show resolver.chosen==null -> flagged.

matt: Nice. Keep monitoring. We'll leave the alert rule in a 72h window and collect samples for the postmortem. Thanks all :rocket:
